verdict.rationale: Fly.io's own docs explicitly claim Machines 'boot in under a second... and scale out to tens of thousands when the traffic arrives' [fly-io-docs-14], directly matching the story. However, this is a first-party marketing claim with no independent benchmark corroboration, and multiple community reports describe unreliable machine boots, stuck instances, and outages under production load [fly-io-comm-5, fly-io-comm-7, fly-io-comm-19], casting doubt on consistent delivery at scale even though they don't directly refute the boot-time/scale-count figures themselves. Missing for 10: independent load-test benchmarks confirming sub-second boot and tens-of-thousands scale, and resolution of community reliability complaints under sustained high-traffic scenarios.
